title: WordPress Apply: the demo company's mailto and tel links lead to the customer's typed mailbox and phone
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wordpress.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wp-residue.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of each case whose name starts with: "the mailbox and phone the customer typed are where the template's company had its own, in every part the sweep reads"; "with no mailbox typed, the demo's e-mail tile goes, and the account that receives the forms' mail is not put in its place"; "a link that mails or calls the template's company leads to the customer's own mailbox and phone, and shows them where it showed the demo's"; "with no mailbox and no phone typed, a link to the demo that is all its block says goes with the block; one inside a sentence is left and said"; "a sweep asked nothing about contacts leaves every mail and phone link as it is"; "a raw HTML row of icon links, or a linked picture, is never cut whole for the one demo link in it"; "a phone link is read as a dialler reads it, every number or address a contact link shows becomes the typed one, and only the first typed one is used"; "a block's own contact link is found however its comment spells it, and the note says why a link was left".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 96).

Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): every mailto:/tel: link to the template's company in every part the sweep reads points at (and shows) the first typed mailbox/phone, read decoded as a dialler reads it; with nothing typed a demo link that is all its block says goes with the block, one in a sentence, a row of icons or a linked picture is left and said; a block's own url is found however its comment spells it; the account that receives form mail never replaces the demo tile.
evidence: Ledger L17, 05/10/2026: after Apply on ja-kinetic (WordPress) the Contact page still invited mail to the demo company (mailto:sales@kinetic.dev, support@..., security@...) and the customer's typed email and phone were on no page. Reds afbe7714f, 1b9ce6e02, 2a389803b, 8815b8f1e; fixes 756c1c8c5, 907052ca9, ce3341830, 3022ab631.
fence: A sweep asked nothing about contacts changes no link; links to anyone but the template company are left.
